items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And because I was the leader then. And I invited Benny out and he played for nothing

ctx.x: Tea dance at the Columbus Park Refectory . And charge a quarter admission and I believe it was Saturday afternoons, yes. And we used to play for them for the money and then I'd pay the guys you know. I'd pay them a little. Not too much. And because I was the leader then. And I invited Benny out and he played for nothing and he, you know nothing. Because we already had a clarinet player.
It's been a long time since he's played for nothing. (LAUGHTER).
